Advanced search can scan the case index, full case JSON, Register of Actions text, parties/counsel/judges, document metadata, financial rows, and archived OCR text. OCR clauses load sidecars lazily and may take a moment. Tip: the search box also accepts field/date namespaces: ocr: title: dn: (decreed-name:) party: counsel: judge: dept: docket: doc: financial: category: status: outcome: vexatious: and from:/to:/on: (filing year). The decreed-name, clerk-category, judge, department, status, outcome, and vexatious fields offer a ▾ picker with counts. Quote multi-word values, e.g. dn:"mok lun wong jow".
